title: Ranger Energy Secures Chevron Contract for Three Additional ECHO Hybrid Rigs (RNGR)
summary: Ranger Energy Services (NYSE:RNGR) has been awarded a new contract by Hess Corporation, a wholly owned subsidiary of Chevron Corporation (CVX), to supply three additional ECHO hybrid workover rigs for operations across the Lower 48 United States. The agreement expands Ranger’s next-generation rig fleet and strengthens its relationship with one of the country’s largest energy producers.
